title: Which Pot?
description: Which Pots adds a new potion storage container. It holds and manages all your potions so that you can keep looting!
body:
A simple quality of life mod adding a storage container for potion effects. Empty all your potions, splash potions, and tipped arrows that you find while looting into this pot and you no longer need to ask your self "Which pot?"

 
Shift Right-Clicking applies a minute of all stored potions, this can be adjusted by adding clay or redstone dust. Milk will clear the pot.
